high_level_description: This image depicts the facade of an old building with a distinct architectural style that suggests it might be from the early to mid-20th century. The building is painted in a light green color, which has faded over time, giving it a weathered appearance. The walls show signs of wear and discoloration, indicating age and exposure to the elements. The building features two windows on the upper floor, each with six panes and closed shutters. Above the windows, there is a decorative element resembling a stylized arch or a crown-like design, painted in a darker shade, possibly red or brown.
